name: Q Cells USA
old_description: Q Cells is a solar panel manufacturer and energy solutions provider. Products include bifacial solar modules, energy storage systems and power electronics, suitable for utility and commercial solar installations.
about:
Q Cells USA, headquartered in Placentia, California, was founded in 1999. The company operates a solar cell production facility in Cartersville, Georgia, marking its commitment to American manufacturing. Ownership details and founders are not publicly disclosed in the provided sources.

The company manufactures bifacial solar panels, solar modules, battery management systems, and inverters, serving utility, commercial, industrial, and residential markets. With a workforce of 100 to 499 employees, Q Cells USA delivers complete energy solutions integrating hardware and software for solar installations and energy storage.

Its customer base includes utilities expanding clean energy capacity, commercial and industrial businesses seeking to reduce energy costs, government entities, and residential homeowners. Notable partnerships include an alliance with Microsoft to explore energy capacity for AI infrastructure.

Q Cells USA emphasizes its U.S. manufacturing footprint and claims the number one market share position for solar modules in the United States. In 2026, it became the first company to achieve UL and IEC certification by TÜV Rheinland for its next-generation solar technology.
